mapper.insert: INSERT INTO quiz_attempt_answer ( attempt_id, question_id, selected_option_ids_json, text_answer, revision, saved_at, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{attemptId}, #{questionId}, #{selectedOptionIdsJson}, #{textAnswer}, 1, #{savedAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE selected_option_ids_json = VALUES(selected_option_ids_json), text_answer = VALUES(text_answer), revision = revision + 1, saved_at = VALUES(saved_at), updated_at = VALUES(updated_at)
mapper.select: SELECT id, attempt_id AS attemptId, question_id AS questionId, selected_option_ids_json AS selectedOptionIdsJson, text_answer AS textAnswer, revision, saved_at AS savedAt, score, pending_manual AS pendingManual, feedback, graded_by AS gradedBy, graded_at AS gradedAt, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM quiz_attempt_answer WHERE attempt_id = #{attemptId} AND question_id = #{questionId}

SELECT id, attempt_id AS attemptId, question_id AS questionId, selected_option_ids_json AS selectedOptionIdsJson, text_answer AS textAnswer, revision, saved_at AS savedAt, score, pending_manual AS pendingManual, feedback, graded_by AS gradedBy, graded_at AS gradedAt, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM quiz_attempt_answer WHERE attempt_id = #{attemptId}

SELECT a.id, a.attempt_id AS attemptId, a.question_id AS questionId, a.text_answer AS textAnswer, a.score, a.pending_manual AS pendingManual, a.feedback, a.graded_by AS gradedBy, a.graded_at AS gradedAt FROM quiz_attempt_answer a INNER JOIN quiz_attempt att ON att.id = a.attempt_id INNER JOIN quiz_question q ON q.id = a.question_id WHERE a.question_id = #{questionId} AND q.type = 'ShortAnswer' AND att.status = 'Submitted'

SELECT id, attempt_id AS attemptId, question_id AS questionId, selected_option_ids_json AS selectedOptionIdsJson, text_answer AS textAnswer, revision, saved_at AS savedAt, score, pending_manual AS pendingManual, feedback, graded_by AS gradedBy, graded_at AS gradedAt, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM quiz_attempt_answer WHERE question_id = #{questionId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM quiz_attempt_answer WHERE attempt_id = #{attemptId} AND pending_manual = 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM quiz_attempt_answer a INNER JOIN quiz_attempt att ON att.id = a.attempt_id WHERE att.quiz_id = #{quizId} AND a.pending_manual = 1 AND att.status = 'Submitted'
